data.title: Cross-Modal Attention for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion under Weak Supervision
data.abstract: We propose a cross-modal attention module that aligns infrared and visible features without paired annotations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent gains, and we discuss the conditions under which the alignment degrades.
data.venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

data.title: Thermal-Guided Pseudo-Labelling for Nighttime Object Detection
data.abstract: Nighttime detection suffers from a lack of annotated data. We generate pseudo-labels from a thermal stream and show that a detector trained on them transfers to unseen city scenes.
